definitions.gloss: tough; tenacious; resilient; strong and flexible
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is both strong and flexible, able to withstand stress without breaking. Used for physical materials, bodies, or figuratively for mental fortitude and willpower. Composed of 強 (strong) + 靭 (tough/pliant).

examples.japanese: {強靭|きょうじん}な⟦{精神力|せいしんりょく}→精神力：17976_seishinryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He has a tenacious mental strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧{強靭|きょうじん}だ。
examples.english: This material is light and tough.

examples.japanese: {強靭|きょうじん}な⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる→鍛え上げる：08247_kitaeageru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Building a tough physique requires years of training.

notes:
USAGE:
{強靭|きょうじん} is a na-adjective used in both physical and figurative contexts. It implies not just strength but also resilience and flexibility — the ability to endure without breaking. Written language and formal contexts are its primary domains.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強靭|きょうじん}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (tenacious spirit)
- {強靭|きょうじん}な⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧ (tough physique)
- {強靭|きょうじん}な⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧ (strong will)
- {強靭|きょうじん}な⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧ (strong stamina)
- ⟦{国土|こくど}→国土：12036_kokudo⟧{強靭|きょうじん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (national resilience — a government policy term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{頑丈|がんじょう}→頑丈：08639_ganjou⟧ means "sturdy" or "solid" and emphasizes hardness and durability. {強靭|きょうじん} emphasizes flexibility and resilience alongside strength. ⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧ is a more everyday word meaning "strong" or "durable."
